basic_info.description: 2-bedroom 2-bathroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 80% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $95,900; 3 = $107,900; 4 = $119,900; 5 = $129,500 etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 2-21-2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 3-18-2025 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity.
